peak-sprays.changelog:
- DUI & Memory Recycling Pool: Slot allocation pool for DUI handles & runtime TXDs eliminates VRAM leaks.
- Race-Free Async DUI Loading: Replaced nested timeouts with async readiness checks.
- Frame Raycast & Brush Optimization: Per-frame cached raycasting and pre-computed sine/cosine unit circle lookups.
- In-Memory Server Caching: Server caches paintings and stroke data in RAM, dropping DB queries on player join & proximity to 0.
